change: `wf green` cannot take `--json`: the flag is gone from the command and there is no global `--json` to fall back to
quote: "Every command: `--json` output mode; no interactive prompts, ever" / "**Agent-first.** `--json` everywhere"
note: §5.6 of SPEC.md says the contract accepts `--json` global *or* per-command, checking globals first. Dropping it from `green` alone would therefore be satisfied by the global; the single constraint under test (green can be asked for JSON) needs both sites. Every other command keeps its own `--json`.
